The design requires an external SPI RAM, such as a Raspberry Pi acting as an emulator, to load and run programs.

results.summary_before: This project is a general-purpose UART with FIFO buffers, developed by Purdue's SoCET team. It supports standard UART signals (rx, tx, cts, rts) and includes FIFO buffers for both transmit and receive paths. The design allows configuration of baud rate and operation mode (idle, transmit, receive, buffer clear) through control pins. It can be tested by connecting to another UART or a USB-to-serial adapter, and it provides error and buffer status flags.

results.summary_before: This project is a 4x4 array multiplier that takes two 4-bit unsigned numbers and outputs their 8-bit product. It is built from 12 full adders and 16 AND gates, following a structural array multiplier architecture. Testing is done by applying two 4-bit inputs via the ui_in pins and reading the product on the uo_out pins. No external hardware is required, and the design is a typical class project for learning digital arithmetic.
